thread:
Alex: quick sync — per the RCA for the outage (RCA-789) we have 4 cross-team action items. listing here so owners can ack + confirm due dates. please reply with owner + date.

Alex: ACTIONS: 1) infra: pin katana kernel patch in canary (owner needed) 2) platform: add fallback routing rule for region eu-west (owner: ?) 3) ml: validate kv-cache behavior on q4 models (owner needed) 4) deploy: add alert on log spike to avoid silent OOMs (owner needed)

Alex: target dates: items 1-2 by EOD Wed (1881235200), 3 by next Tue, 4 by end of sprint. say if unrealistic.

Marta: I can take action 2 (platform). EOD Wed works. I will create the config PR and post link here. :white_check_mark:

Ben: I can grab action 4 (deploy alerts) but need help from eng-infra for metric names. ETA Fri if no blocker.

Priya: I own action 3 (ml kv-cache validation). moving to my board. aiming for next Tue but might need +2 days depending on long run tests.

infra-bot: Tracker updated: https://tracker.redwood.ai/issue/RCA-789 - labels: rca, cross-team, priority-high

Alex: @Marta thanks. @Ben can you call out which metrics you need? ping infra-ops if you need dashboards.

Ben: calling out metric names: gpu.memory.used, process.resident_size. also need guidance on sampling window. @infra-bot can you attach the current dashboard?

infra-bot: Attached dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/d/ops/gpu-memory - added Ben as watcher.

Marta: PR opened for fallback routing: https://git.redwood.ai/platform/pull/314 - reviewers: @Alex, @Priya. I set the canary to 10% by default.

Priya: noted @Alex. I'll run 3 long-run tests starting tonight and post the results to the tracker. if flaky, I'll ask for help.

Alex: great — summary: Marta owns 2 (EOD Wed), Ben owns 4 (Fri), Priya owns 3 (next Tue +/-2d). still need owner for action 1 (kernel pin). who from infra can take that?

Ben: tagging @infra-team in the tracker. if no response by tomorrow morning I'll escalate to infra oncall.

Marta: small ask — can infra also confirm whether pinning the kernel will require node reprovisioning? that affects our rollout window.

infra-bot: infra oncall assigned: @Sam (oncall) — Sam please advise on kernel pinning path.

Sam: Sam here — I can own action 1. quick note: pinning will require rolling reboot of canary nodes, estimate 30m ops. target Wed morning; I'll coordinate with Marta for routing window.

Alex: perfect. please update RCA ticket with Sam's ETA and Sam add the reboot runbook link. thanks everyone — will check back EOD Wed for progress and close items as they land. :pray:
